rag.name: LO.Modal.Hilbert.S5.Kripke.complete

informal_statement: The modal logics S5 and KT4B are equivalent in terms of their frame semantics, meaning they capture the same sets of frame properties.
informal_proof:
First, we recognize that S5 and KT4B are both modal logics defined over frames, which are structures used to interpret necessity and possibility operators. The frame properties differ between S5 and KT4B, but through a detailed analysis, it can be shown that they endow the same sets of frame properties when considering their respective logics.

The theorem is achieved by applying a series of frame class equivalences. Specifically, by establishing that both logics satisfy the classes of reflexive, Euclidean, and transitive frames, and by demonstrating the subset relationships between these frame properties, we conclude that the logics are equivalent. Essentially, since both logics impose the same constraints on frame accessibility relations, their equivalent frame semantics lead to logical equivalence.

theorem equiv_S5_KT4B : (Hilbert.S5 ℕ) =ₛ (Hilbert.KT4B ℕ) := by
  /-
    ⊢ LO.System.Equiv (LO.Modal.Hilbert.S5 Nat) (LO.Modal.Hilbert.KT4B Nat)
  -/
  apply Kripke.equiv_of_eq_FrameClass ReflexiveEuclideanFrameClass ReflexiveTransitiveSymmetricFrameClass;
  /-
    ⊢ Eq LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveEuclideanFrameClass LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveTra …
  -/
  apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_subset;
    /-
      case a
      ⊢ HasSubset.Subset LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveEuclideanFrameClass LO.Modal.Kripk …
    -/
  . rintro F ⟨F_refl, F_eucl⟩;
    /-
      case a.intro
      F : LO.Modal.Kripke.Frame
      F_refl : Reflexive F.Rel
      F_eucl : Euclidean F.Rel
      ⊢ Membership.mem LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveTransitiveSymmetricFrameClass F
    -/
    refine ⟨F_refl, trans_of_refl_eucl F_refl F_eucl, symm_of_refl_eucl F_refl F_eucl⟩;
    /-
      🎉 no goals
    -/
    /-
      case a
      ⊢ HasSubset.Subset LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveTransitiveSymmetricFrameClass LO.M …
    -/
  . rintro F ⟨F_refl, F_eucl, F_symm⟩;
    /-
      case a.intro.intro
      F : LO.Modal.Kripke.Frame
      F_refl : Reflexive F.Rel
      F_eucl : Transitive F.Rel
      F_symm : Symmetric F.Rel
      ⊢ Membership.mem LO.Modal.Kripke.ReflexiveEuclideanFrameClass F
    -/
    refine ⟨F_refl, eucl_of_symm_trans F_symm F_eucl⟩;
    /-
      🎉 no goals
    -/
